name: DataBench
why_it_matters: Data journalists routinely load CSVs, reason over them, and write accurate summaries—exactly the end-to-end workflow this benchmark evaluates.
task_shape: Models are given real-world tabular datasets and natural-language questions, and must load the data, reason over rows/columns, and return factual answers grounded in the table.
signals: Uses 65 real-world datasets across diverse domains with typed answer categories that make grading unambiguous.
Focuses on question answering rather than full narrative generation, so long-form summary quality is only partially tested.
